Package dev.swordai.core.vision

package dev.swordai.core.vision
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    EyeCheck
    Measures how well the drawn picture (SyntheticEye) matches the real one.
    MaskExtractor
    Turns a rendered RGBA frame into the enemy masks.
    MaskFrame
    What one captured frame boils down to: two enemy masks and a few numbers measured on them.
    PlayerFigure
    The player model as the game draws it, worked out from a PlayerPose: six boxes (head, body, two arms, two legs) with the sizes, pivots and animation of the game's own model, each including its outer skin layer.
    PlayerFigure.Part
    One box of the model.
    PlayerPose
    Everything about a player that decides how the game draws it at one moment: where it stands, which way it faces, and how far its limbs are into their animations.
    SyntheticEye
    Draws what a fighter would see of one opponent, for a body that has no screen (a fake player on the server).
    SyntheticEye.Box
    One box of the opponent, seen from the eye at the origin.
    ViewGeometry
    Camera maths in Minecraft's conventions: yaw 0 faces +Z and grows clockwise seen from above, positive pitch looks down.
